ms.promise:
・Code will be developed to cover most of the triggers, actions, or outputs mentioned here:
・Triggers: Receive data over an HTTP endpoint, through a POST method or a GET method with query parameters, an auto-generated form, or a DIDComm endpoint of the following types:W3C JWT Credential, a PeerDID, a PRISM-DID, a predefined Key/Value pair, an API-Key, or various types of DIDComm messages.
・The following actions can be used and chained as needed: Resolution of a DID, verification of a Credential, validation of certain data inside triggers.
・The following outputs will be provided and triggered depending on the outcome of the previous actions: HTTP request, issuing a credential, sending DIDComm messages, creating, updating, and deleting DIDs, the generation of an Out-of-band invitation connection, creation of a JWT Token (for authentication).
・While we plan to support all these triggers, actions, and outputs, there might be unforeseen problems or yet unknown opportunities, which could lead us to change a minority of them. If this happens, we will document the changes in the report for this milestone.
・Code will be added to manage chained flows as templates.
・Unit-Tests for each of thes
